svg.title: REMAIN-1: weight regained 6 months after stopping tirzepatide
svg.desc: REMAIN-1: weight regained 6 months after stopping tirzepatide. Sham (n=74): 8.2%. Revita, all (n=176): 5.1%. Revita ≤10 cm (n=22): 6.9%. Revita 12–18 cm (n=107): 4.7%. Revita ≥20 cm (n=47): 3.8%. The three ablation-length groups are post hoc.
